method: LIVE drive of the patched dosbox-pure trace core via the trace-maze.ts harness (new `statustick` phase). driveToFreeRoam lands a stock 3-member party (THESUS/TEMPEST/LYSANDR) at gx127 gy121 f0 in free-roam; encdisable2 suppression (per-frame zero of 0x4e08/0x4e68 planes + *0x5032/4 + code-patch jl->jmp at ovl+0x2d12) lets the party walk 70+ turns with ZERO encounters. Char-record base for slot i = DGROUP base + 0x4400 + i*0x1b0; named fields read/poked at base + ABS_OFFSET + i*0x1b0. turn_counter read as u32 at base+0x4f80. SP read as s16 at base+0x4404+i*0x1b0. All confirmations are POKE -> walk -> OBSERVE on the running engine. Raw results: /tmp/wiz6-statustick.json (regenerable: pnpm tsx tools/libretro/trace-maze.ts statustick).
summary: LIVE-CONFIRMED every static-RE claim from maze-per-turn-poison.json + maze-regen-tick.json, AND resolved the char-record field-identity conflict the prompt flagged. ANCHOR: race=abs0x4585, sex=abs0x4586, class=abs0x4587, status_level=abs0x4589 -- so the character-record-extended-map.json layout is CORRECT and its OWN conflicting side-note ('sex at 0x4589') is REFUTED; 0x4589 is status_level, 0x4586 is sex. Stock party live values match (slot0 THESUS race0/sex0/class0 HP8/8 SP126/126; slot1 TEMPEST race10/sex1/class0; slot2 LYSANDR race8/sex0/class3). The per-turn SP drain schedule is EXACTLY deterministic: 24/24 observed drains fired at turn%10==5 on slot=(turn%60)/10, magnitude -1 for un-afflicted members. POISON: poking poison_amount(+0x458d)=7 made the drain 8 (=7+1) CONFIRMED. STATUS GATE: poking status_level(+0x4589)=3 EXCLUDED that slot from the drain; =2 still drained -> gate is <3 CONFIRMED. CONDITIONS: poking conditions[1]/[4] (+0x450a+i)=5 decayed -1 per qualifying tick, floored at 0; a 0xFF sentinel was preserved CONFIRMED. HP-REGEN VIT-TRIPLE: poking vit_a(+0x458a)=5 (vit_b/c=0) on a real member with lowered HP regenerated +5 HP per qualifying tick, capped at maxHP -> formula HP += (+0x458a) - (+0x458b) - (+0x458c) CONFIRMED; stock VIT-triple is all-zero so maze HP regen is a NO-OP for stock chars. MANA-REGEN: with school-0 skill poked to 20 and maxMana to 99, mana regenerated by a random 0..skill amount ONLY for the round-robin-selected member on its own turn (never both probed slots at once) CONFIRMED. SURPRISE/CORRECTION to cadence: a TURN IS ONE dungeon_main_loop PASS, NOT one discrete player action. Idle (60 frames, no key) advanced turn_counter by 0; but a single held-key movement action advanced it by 4..9 (it spans several loop passes). So the static 'turn_counter increments once per party ACTION' is wrong in MAGNITUDE -- it increments once per loop iteration and a held movement is many iterations -- though the spirit (idle does not tick; movement does) holds. Consequence: the %10==5 / %60 round-robin schedule advances several positions per held move, so over a single forward step multiple slots can be drained.

findings.claim: CONFIRMED char-record field layout (char base = DGROUP 0x4400 + slot*0x1b0): race @ +0x4585(abs), sex @ +0x4586, class @ +0x4587, status_level @ +0x4589. This RESOLVES the prompt's conflict: 0x4589 is status_level (NOT sex). The conflicting note in character-record-extended-map.json that placed sex at 0x4589 is REFUTED; sex lives at 0x4586. The character-record-extended-map.json PRIMARY layout (race 0x4585 / alignment(=sex byte) 0x4586 / class 0x4587) is correct.

evidence.details: Live free-roam read of the stock party: slot0 (THESUS) race=0(Human) sex=0 class=0(Fighter) HP=8/8 SP=126/126; slot1 (TEMPEST) race=10(Mook) sex=1 class=0(Fighter) HP=9/9 SP=123/123; slot2 (LYSANDR) race=8(Felpurr) sex=0 class=3(Thief) HP=5/5 SP=87/87. These match character-record-extended-map.json stock_character_values exactly at offsets 0x4585/0x4586/0x4587, proving the base+offset law. Full 0x4585..0x4595 region dump for all slots captured in /tmp/wiz6-statustick.json steps.anchor.dump. status_level 0x4589 confirmed distinct from sex 0x4586 by the poke test in finding status-level-gate (poking 0x4589 changes drain participation; it is NOT the sex byte).

on_disk_pcfile.law: on-disk record offset = (abs - 0x4400) + 0x18  (abs - 0x43e8 for the +0x19x BSS region used in character-record-extended-map.json -> identical result for these fields)

findings.claim: turn_counter (DGROUP 0x4f80, u32) increments once per dungeon_main_loop PASS, NOT once per discrete player action. IDLE does not advance it (0 increments over 60 idle frames); a single HELD-KEY movement action advances it by several (observed 4..9 per action: forward 4/9, left 6, right 8). So 'a turn' = one maze-loop iteration; a held movement is many iterations. CORRECTION to maze-per-turn-poison.json finding when-the-tick-runs which said 'incremented exactly once per resolved party ACTION/turn' -- that is wrong in magnitude (it is once per loop pass; a single held move = multiple passes). The status tick (gated turn%10==5) therefore fires several times within one held movement.

evidence.details: IDLE probe: read 0x4f80=3, c.step 60 frames with NO key, re-read 0x4f80=3 (delta 0) -> idle does not tick. Then held-key moves: up 3->7 (+4), left 7->13 (+6), right 13->21 (+8), up 21->30 (+9). The variation in per-action delta is the held-key duration (frames the key is down) x loop-iterations-per-frame; the increment is per loop iteration. NOT tested: whether a door-OPEN / cast / use menu action increments 0x4f80 (the maze-per-turn-poison.json open-question); only movement/turn actions were exercised here.

findings.claim: The per-turn SP drain is EXACTLY the deterministic round-robin from the static RE: for each member i with status_level<3, SP(+0x4404) -= (poison_amount(+0x458d)+1), clamped >=0, fires ONLY when turn%10==5 AND (turn%60)/10 == i. Un-afflicted members (poison_amount 0) still lose exactly 1 SP on their scheduled turn (drain = 0+1). 24/24 observed drains matched: slot (turn%60)/10 drained -1 at turn%10==5, cyclically slot0@%60=5, slot1@%60=15, slot2@%60=25, repeating every 60 turns.

evidence.details: With all 3 slots forced status_level=0 poison_amount=0, sampled SP+turn at frame granularity over 72 held-key actions. Every SP change was -1 and occurred on a turn with turn%10==5 selecting slot (turn%60)/10. Sample (fired_turn -> slot): 65->s0, 75->s1, 85->s2, 125->s0, 135->s1, 145->s2, ... 505->s2 (24 events, all OK, all -1). Confirms the deterministic gate (NOT rng) and the once-per-60-turns-per-slot stagger.

findings.claim: poison_amount = abs +0x458d (1 byte). Drain = poison_amount + 1. CONFIRMED by poke: setting slot0's +0x458d = 7 made its scheduled SP drain -8 (=7+1) instead of -1.

evidence.details: Poke slot0 +0x458d=7, +0x4589=0; walked to slot0's scheduled drain turn; observed SP 85->77 (delta -8) = poison_amount(7)+1. Matches maze-per-turn-poison.json drain-formula-and-field exactly.

findings.claim: status_level = abs +0x4589 (1 byte). The drain (and the whole per-member tick) is gated status_level < 3. CONFIRMED by poke: setting a slot's +0x4589 = 3 EXCLUDED it from the drain (SP unchanged across its scheduled window); setting it = 2 STILL drained it. So gate is strictly < 3, and 0x4589 is status_level (disambiguated from sex 0x4586).

evidence.details: Poke slot1 +0x4589=3: walked >=1 full slot1 window (turn%60==15 seen); SP stayed 110 (excluded=true). Poke slot1 +0x4589=2: SP drained 110->109 on its next window (drained=true). Confirms the `cmp byte[bx+0x4589],3; jc` gate (enter iff <3) from maze-per-turn-poison.json/maze-regen-tick.json.

findings.claim: The conditions[10] block at abs +0x450a (bytes 0x450a..0x4513) decays by 1 per qualifying tick (turn%10==5), floored at 0; sentinel 0xFF is NEVER decremented (preserved). CONFIRMED by poke: conditions[1] and conditions[4] each set to 5 counted down to 0 over 5 qualifying ticks; conditions[3] set to 0xFF stayed 0xFF.

evidence.details: Poke slot2 +0x450a+1=5, +0x450a+4=5, +0x450a+3=0xFF; walked; after 5 qualifying ticks both c1 and c4 reached 0 (decayed -1/tick, floor 0) and c3 stayed 0xFF. Matches maze-regen-tick.json conditions10-decay (param4=1 step, sentinels {0,0xFF} preserved).

findings.claim: HP regen per qualifying tick = (+0x458a) - (+0x458b) - (+0x458c), added to current HP (+0x4400), capped at maxHP (+0x4402). (The rng(param2) base term is rng(0)=0 in the maze call, so it contributes nothing.) CONFIRMED by poke: vit_a(+0x458a)=5, vit_b/c=0, lowered HP -> HP gained EXACTLY +5 per qualifying tick (1->6->11->16->21->26->31), capped at the poked maxHP. STOCK chars have the VIT-triple = [0,0,0] (live-read), so maze HP regen is a NO-OP for the stock party (HP does not change on movement). The subtractive terms (0x458b/0x458c) being 0 on stock means maze movement never drains/kills via this path for stock chars.

evidence.details: Poke slot1 +0x458a=5, +0x458b=0, +0x458c=0, maxHP(+0x4402)=100, HP(+0x4400)=1. Held-key walk: HP changed +5 at each qualifying tick: 1->6,6->11,11->16,16->21,21->26,26->31 (six +5 steps), then would cap at 100. Confirms maze-regen-tick.json hp-regen-formula (param2=0,param4=1 from the call site -> HP += vit_a - vit_b - vit_c). Stock VIT-triple read [0,0,0] for all live members -> regen is 0 in normal play.

findings.claim: Per-school mana regen runs ONLY for the single round-robin-selected member each qualifying turn (the same member taking the poison drain), NOT for all members. The added amount is random 0..school_skill (rng(skill+1)), per school, capped at maxMana. CONFIRMED by poke: with school-0 skill(+0x4504)=20 and maxMana(+0x4412)=99 on two real slots, mana increased only on the slot whose round-robin turn it was (slot0 and slot2 each gained at distinct times, never both at the same observation), by varying amounts (+8,+13,+3 for one; +10,+4,+15 for the other) consistent with rng(0..20). SP regen, by contrast, is DISABLED on the maze tick (param3=0) and was never observed to increase.

evidence.details: Poke slots 0 and 2: school-0 maxMana(+0x4412)=99, current mana(+0x4410)=10, school-0 skill(+0x4504)=20. Walked ~140 actions. Mana changes (slot0_delta / slot2_delta): only ONE slot moved per observation, deltas: slot2 +10, slot0 +8, slot2 +4, slot0 +13, slot0 +3, slot2 +15 -> random 0..skill, gated on the round-robin select flag (param5) per maze-regen-tick.json mana-regen-gated-on-select-flag. (Mana cur@0x4410+s*4, max@0x4412+s*4, school-skill bytes @0x4504+s confirmed reachable.)

static_re_vs_live.status_level_field_0x4589: CONFIRMED at the predicted offset; the prompt-flagged conflict (sex vs status_level at 0x4589) RESOLVED -> 0x4589 = status_level, 0x4586 = sex.
static_re_vs_live.poison_amount_field_0x458d: CONFIRMED at the predicted offset; drain = value+1.
static_re_vs_live.vit_triple_0x458a_c: CONFIRMED at the predicted offsets; HP regen = +0x458a - 0x458b - 0x458c per tick, capped maxHP. STOCK values are all-zero (regen no-op for stock party).
static_re_vs_live.turn_counter_0x4f80: CONFIRMED location + the %10==5 / %60-round-robin schedule (24/24). CORRECTED magnitude: it increments per dungeon_main_loop PASS (idle=0, one held move = 4..9), NOT once per discrete action as maze-per-turn-poison.json stated.
static_re_vs_live.mana_regen: CONFIRMED gated on the round-robin select flag (only the selected member regens mana per qualifying turn); SP regen DISABLED on the maze tick (never observed).

Whether status_level 1..2 (afflicted-but-not-dead) is actually reachable in normal play, or only via poke -- the gate behaves as <3 either way (live-confirmed at 2 and 3).
